raw_text:
Authentication Bypass - Session Fixation Attack

Session fixation vulnerability in /api/login endpoint.
Application accepts session identifiers from cookie without regeneration.

Attack steps:
1. Attacker sets victim's session cookie to known value (e.g., session=ATTACKER_CHOSEN_VALUE)
2. Victim logs in successfully
3. Attacker uses same session ID to access victim's account

Vulnerable code in auth.py line 123:
  session['user_id'] = user.id  # No session regeneration!

Session hijacking successful with credentials:
Admin session: session=AdminSession123456
Admin email: admin.user@acmecorp.com
Backup contact: admin.backup@gmail.com
AWS credentials found in session storage: AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
JWT token intercepted: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiIsInNlc3Npb25fZml4YXRpb24iOiJ0cnVlIn0.maliciousSig
Database admin endpoint: db-admin.staging.local
GCP token leaked: ya29.a0AfH6SMCw_SessionFixationToken_example
Testing performed from: 10.0.1.1
SendGrid key for notifications: SG.SessionFixationAlert_key
